CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: chin, neck, collarbones, shoulders and upper chest.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A LONG MULTICOLOUR STATION NECKLACE: a fine gold chain with mixed-cut coloured stones set along it, each in its own gold bezel: emerald-cut, oval, marquise, pear and round stones in yellow, green, lilac, pale blue, royal blue, pink and garnet red, mixed with no pattern, some linked edge to edge and a few hanging as small drops. Coloured faceted stones only, in many shapes; no pearls, no charms, no letters, no clear stones dominating.

SCALE TEST: Worn wrapped twice, one row lies on the collarbones and the second falls to the upper chest. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
